program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((core (rotate-ccw g))
                  (ch (rows core))
                  (cw (cols core))
                  (period (+ ch 1)))
             (build-grid (+ (* 2 ch) 3)
                         (+ cw 2)
                         (r c)
                         (if (zero? (modulo r period))
                             (if (or (zero? c) (= c (+ cw 1))) 7 1)
                             (if (or (zero? c) (= c (+ cw 1)))
                                 1
                                 (at core (- (modulo r period) 1) (- c 1)))))))))
rival_program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((core (rotate-ccw g))
                  (ch (rows core))
                  (cw (cols core))
                  (period (+ ch 1)))
             (build-grid (+ (* (length (filter (lambda (color) (not (= color 7))) (grid-colors g))) (+ ch 1)) 1)
                         (+ cw 2)
                         (r c)
                         (if (zero? (modulo r period))
                             (if (or (zero? c) (= c (+ cw 1))) 7 1)
                             (if (or (zero? c) (= c (+ cw 1)))
                                 1
                                 (at core (- (modulo r period) 1) (- c 1)))))))))
